candidate.representation: Per output row and each consecutive group of eight input columns, retain the single largest absolute source weight with stable lowest-index tie breaking

selection_rule: Source-weight-only stable magnitude selection. No calibration, target, validation, or final data may affect support.
execution_boundary: The quality oracle may use an equivalent dense masked matrix for diagnostic execution. This does not prove physical sparse execution; any passing quality result requires a separately installed sparse kernel and physical profiler evidence.
decision: Authorize one read-only layer-1 quality oracle for the fixed 1:8 support on complete QKV and O weights, followed by exact source MLP diagnostic only. A miss closes direct per-layer source-attention compression across the tested head-selection, shared-low-rank, and structured-support families. No density, group, retained-count, scoring, data, source, seed, or gate sweep is authorized.
claim_boundary: No-model fixed structured-support and arithmetic review only; no sparse attention quality, physical execution, residual realization, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
